breaks.quote: he came to me with a deadline: the December meeting, in his own voice.
breaks.why: The deadline is claimed as pressure but no clause shows what Aiman could lose if he misses it, so the reader has to guess the stakes.

breaks.quote: He tried out his opening line on his morning customers. Before December, he was confident.
breaks.why: The weak ending is propped up with an extra scene and a flat claim of confidence instead of raising what is at risk.
